st_porteurs.name: Chemin de la Barrière · Gate Lane
st_porteurs.alt: An eye-level view of the market gate square at rush hour in clear daylight, with shoppers in the market beyond the arch: a gold-beret mime lays a gold meter rule across a crate of vegetables; one rolls a big barrel across the cobbles; on the right one swings the wooden farm gate shut, with the ribboned maypole rising behind it and a farmer driving a cart in the distance; one catches runaway tomatoes in a wire trap; one gasps, hands on cheeks, at his blue casserole dish smashed on the cobbles; one sets down a crate of posies. A tabby cat naps in an empty crate among the lavender pots. The open stone arch on the left leads back to the market square; the blue, green and red doors along the back wall and the yellow door on the right lead on.

porteurs.name: Allée des Porteurs · Porters' Alley
porteurs.alt: Looking up a steep, winding stepped alley from its foot, soft blue-green morning mist and a pale sun at the top: by the blue door in the foreground a mime throws a paper jet into a water tub; one climbs the steps carrying a big crate on his back; one strikes a ballet pose as he sets his basket down; far up in the mist one lifts a crate upside down over his head; on a little balcony terrace one places a plate on the table for a grandmother; in the right foreground one uses a long lever to take the lid off a crate. A pigeon on a step and a girl carrying a milk can. The blue door on the left leads back to the lane.

lanceurs.name: Rue des Lanceurs · Throwers' Street
lanceurs.alt: A warm summer-night street fete seen from a balcony, strings of glowing paper lanterns under a starry sky: in the foreground a gold-beret mime covers his crate of strawberries with a checked cloth; one throws a red ball high toward the lanterns for a jumping dog; one gulps his lemonade so fast it splashes; a gold-beret mime pulls the big canvas back over a cart of ice blocks; behind the ice one shivers with chattering teeth; one shakes a tub of bran until it flies. A little girl holds up a paper lantern. The green door on the left leads back to the lane.

seau.name: Ruelle du Seau-Renversé · Upturned-Bucket Lane
seau.alt: A summer back lane with an old wall telephone, a shuttered window, crates, a water trough and a horse: a mime dashes off with a salmon fillet, a cat at his heels; one hangs up the telephone; one knocks over a milk churn; a gold-beret mime shuts the shutter with a red lobster; a gold-beret mime reopens a crate as a little kangaroo hops out; one crosses his arms beside the horse at the trough. The red door on the left leads back to the lane.

balancoires.name: Allée des Balançoires · Swings Alley
balancoires.alt: A shady summer courtyard under a big tree with a rope swing, a shuttered window, a bell post and a low stone arch: a mime blushes as a lady in green offers him a rose; one swings high balancing a tray of cups; a green-beret mime rounds dough into a loaf; one bends double under the low arch with a hand mirror; a gold-beret mime half-opens a shutter; one rings the bell. The little yellow door far back on the left leads back to the lane.
